questions.prompt: What is the most dependable way to apply “Re-exports and Public APIs” in a new program?
options: Start with a minimal example, state its assumptions, verify the expected behavior, and test a relevant boundary case.

questions.prompt: When a result involving “Re-exports and Public APIs” differs from your prediction, what should you do first?
